Queue build 42563769510 went red on Dogfood Regression Gate (1/3), in `packages/qa/dogfood/test/admin-route-nonadmin-refusal.dogfood.test.ts:618` ("#9482 C9: every derived /admin/ route refuses a non-admin"). The stack serves two /admin/ routes the suite does not classify:

- `POST /api/v1/auth/admin/sso/get-groups-claim`
- `POST /api/v1/auth/admin/sso/set-groups-claim`

Neither route is on main. They come from #31755, so this is #31755's regression, not a flake. The fix is to add both routes to that suite's `EXPECTED`, with the answer a non-admin must get. PR-side CI runs only the affected subset, so this test never ran on the PR.

The same build also ejected #31751 and #31773. I re-queued #31773 (seat 2) now that #31755 is out of the queue. #31809 was filed as a "queue-flake anchor" for this signature; I noted on it that the failure is real.
